jobs.description: Bolna AI is hiring a founding machine-learning engineer to own the lifecycle of models used in high-volume production voice conversations. The work includes multilingual conversational-data pipelines, training-data cleaning and labeling, model fine-tuning, and evaluation datasets covering transcription accuracy, naturalness, interruption handling, latency, and end-to-end quality. The engineer will deploy models into latency-sensitive production systems, monitor real-world behavior, diagnose regressions, and improve accuracy and reliability. Candidates should have at least three years of hands-on machine-learning experience, strong Python and PyTorch fundamentals, exposure to distributed training, and modern fine-tuning approaches such as LoRA, QLoRA, DPO, or RLHF. Speech, streaming inference, quantization, distillation, ASR, TTS, VAD, and multilingual Indian-language experience are valuable.

Nightfall AI is hiring an engineer or scientist to build AI systems for real-time data-loss prevention and insider-risk products. Responsibilities include using Python to analyze data, explore NLP and other model architectures, fine-tune models, benchmark and monitor accuracy, automate training and deployment, support real-time inference, and design agentic workflows. The role also uses Go or another systems language for services that process streaming data through distributed caching and concurrent execution. Candidates should have at least five years of industry experience with relevant graduate education, fluent Python plus Go, C++, or Java, strong algorithms and data structures, and experience delivering deep-learning systems to production at scale. PyTorch, LLM fine-tuning, AWS or GCP, Kafka, Redis, PostgreSQL, and MLOps are useful additions.

Nightfall AI is seeking a senior backend engineer to build reliable, secure, low-latency services that process and detect sensitive data at scale. The engineer will create highly available authentication and API services, maintain mission-critical databases, operate autoscaling streaming services, instrument customer-level utilization, and document internal and public services. The role requires at least eight years of experience, expertise in Python, Go, Java, C++, or another systems language, and experience operating systems at thousands of requests per second with strong availability. Candidates should understand production deployment, monitoring, reliability, distributed SQL or NoSQL storage, and large-scale real-time data pipelines using technology such as Kafka, Hadoop, Hive, Storm, or ZooKeeper. The position also expects technical leadership and the ability to decompose complex business problems.

Bolna AI is hiring a software engineer to build reliable systems supporting millions of real-time voice-AI conversations across languages and telephony environments. The engineer will design high-volume backend services, own features from requirements through monitoring, improve observability and fault tolerance, and work on streaming audio, webhooks, queues, scheduling, concurrency, and low-latency communication. The role also covers APIs, SDKs, integrations, dashboards, testing standards, documentation, and incident response. Candidates need at least two years of production backend experience with Python, Go, Java, Node.js, or a similar language; solid knowledge of algorithms, databases, networking, operating systems, distributed systems, relational data modeling, transactions, and query performance; and experience with REST, event-driven, or real-time APIs. Voice orchestration, WebSockets, ASR, LLM, and TTS integrations are advantageous.

Metaforms is hiring a senior product engineer to own AI-native product areas from customer discovery and solution design through implementation, release, measurement, and iteration. The engineer will speak directly with research agencies and operations teams, decide what to build based on user and business signals, ship across frontend, backend, and AI systems, and contribute customer insight to product strategy. The position asks for three to seven years of software-engineering experience and strong full-stack skills with React, TypeScript, Python, and AWS. Candidates should demonstrate product judgment, comfort converting ambiguous needs into scoped solutions, and experience building or working closely with AI or LLM-powered systems. Experience with B2B SaaS startups, developer tools, copilots, workflow automation, agents, context engineering, or evaluation frameworks is beneficial.
